kind: SYNTHETIC timing estimates (no real data, no labels); real views may converge differently (MLP early stopping); one process under lcr.sema, OMP_NUM_THREADS=1; cpu_s = process CPU time of the measuring process
fixture: lcr.audit.synthetic_D (OSF_DEFENSE_FIT 15,434 / AUDIT_FIT 6,065 / INNER_SELECTION 2,235 / assessment 13,936 rows, P(S=1) = 0.68) + synthetic_release i8o64 (income 8 per class x 2, occupation 64 per class x 5 predicted classes + 1 reserved token; SEX-tilted 10%) and its synthetic_d1 (same tokens, learned-style q); FINAL slate (LR x5, MLP x4, HGB x4, DA_LR, DA_MLP) + cell readers {0.5, 1, 5}; the AUC- and CE-selected attackers refit at attacker seeds 0-2; three code families (code / token / prob); a temporary lcr-named unit store with the registered 83-code composition bank (real registration and closure checks); token-only family with the cell readers only (L4b)

registered_control_limits.null: every view: held-out AUC_B <= 0.5 + 3.5 sd0 (sd0 = Mann-Whitney null sd on half B)
registered_control_limits.XOR: AUC_B(pair) > 0.75 and AUC_B(v1) <= null threshold and AUC_B(v2) <= null threshold
registered_control_limits.ROT_r1_ROT_r2: AUC_B(v_i) > 0.75 and AUC_B(pair) > 0.75 and serialisation exact
registered_control_limits.null_calibration: 5 permutations (seed CONTROL_SEED + 100 + rep); pass iff no exceedance of 0.5 + 3.5 sd0
registered_control_limits.realised_threshold_rule: the realised null threshold must equal the source's within 1e-12 (fixed split and permutation seeds on the same roles); otherwise a technical failure
registered_control_limits.plants_in_candidate_bank: never (in-memory / temporary-directory releases, never saved as units)

L4b.rule: the token-only DIAGNOSTIC family is audited with the exact token-identity cell readers only: CC_alpha{0.5, 1, 5} on tok_i and CCpair_alpha{0.5, 1, 5} on the exact tuple (INNER-selected unseen-tuple fallback), both ignore-the-other-recipient banks, the same dual AUC / CE selection (dpc.audit._select); inner: lcr.audit.inner_family_cells; assessment: lcr.audit.final_audit_cells
L4b.rationale: for a pure categorical input the per-cell readers are the direct finite-sample Bayes readers of the token; the FINAL slate on a one-hot of tokens is a regularised approximation of them; the family is diagnostic only
L4b.unchanged: the complete-interface family (primary, nominated and composed) and the probability-only family keep the full FINAL slate + cell readers
L4b.cost_before: full-slate token family 27.85 CPU-s per synthetic i8o64 unit (first timing run)

alias_cache: L5: exact view-fingerprint alias reuse within a seed (path recorded per family; bitwise identical to recomputation); opportunistic, no saving assumed in the estimates beyond the D1 token family
d0_reuse_decision: RECOMPUTE: the admitted cbp inner audits lack the token-only and probability-only families, so the exact parity rule fails; all 81 D0 code and 9 reference inner units are recomputed (aud__ namespace); cbp_parity compares the recomputed primary family with the admitted cbp record

bank.codes_note: 83 registered codes per seed (lcr.run.code_ids()): D0 27 (DIRECT-TASK, FINE-TASK, CLASS-ONLY i1o1, 24 privacy maps), D1 fixed-map 26 (same tokens as D0, learned q), new fits 30 (C-TASK, 24 weighted, 5 constrained); every code at most 8 / 64 states per predicted class (i8o64 shapes). Each code inner unit audits three families (code primary + token-only + probability-only diagnostics); a D1 unit reuses its D0 map's token family (L5)

assessment.note: about 20 locked labels per seed (lead): ~15 codes (P*, N*, J*, T*, C*, C_pair*, Q, best D1 control + its D0, best weighted, C-TASK, 5 constrained arms; aliases deduplicated), SRC|U, SRC|RAW-J, E, F, F0. SRC|U is costed (a) with the freeze list + the scored codes (~20; exact, see recommendation) and (b) with all 83 codes (upper bound). Token-only / probability-only diagnostics are scored only for the registered decoder-ablation pair (the best D1 fixed-map control and its D0 map; lead's lcr.eval_lock); every other code scores the primary family only

estimates.d0_recompute_extra_basis: what reusing the admitted cbp audits would have saved: the primary code family of the 27 D0 codes and the 3 references per seed (the token-only and probability-only diagnostics are needed under either choice)
estimates.assessment_basis: per seed: 15 codes x the primary family at the i8o64 cost (+ token (cells only, L4b) / prob diagnostics for 2 codes in the _with_code_diagnostics figure, for all codes in _diagnostics_on_every_code); both sources' five own families; SRC|U composed with 20 codes (freeze list + scored codes; the composed code bank is fitted once per unit and shared across the four composing families by the content memo) or all 83 (upper); E / F / F0 at the five-family source cost plus one cells family each for F / F0
estimates.safety_note: synthetic MLP early stopping converges fast; cbp's synthetic estimate (2.89 CPU-h) against about 2.8 CPU-h measured for its lead's audit stages; the x2 margin is the scheduling budget
